title: Lvl-10 data-flow checklist - every process that must kick in as the fleet hits 100%

processes.name: Goal parse snapshot
processes.what: /api/goals poll parses all agent files; snapshot reaches 80/80 (100%)

processes.name: Reset arm
processes.what: GOAL_RESET_PENDING re-armed (armed=true) by the 100% gate in /api/goals

processes.name: Level up -> 10
processes.what: _check_level_up fires: level 9->10, report memory/levels/level_10_*.md, levels.json updated

processes.name: Forecast refresh
processes.what: /api/goals/forecast recomputes on stale signature: next10.json, forecast-latest.md, history snapshot, calibration.json

processes.name: UI level chip
processes.what: Portal header Lv chip + goals banner show Level 10 (browser-verified)

processes.name: Cycle transition
processes.what: goal_cycle_auto.py consumes armed flag: archives old goals, drafts next cycle, commits

processes.name: Level gate re-arm
processes.what: After transition, new goal set -> level counter re-gated (signature change), no double count
